name: Video Watch - Transcript, Summary, Obsidian Note

parameters.content:
## Video Watch
Fill in **Video Input**, then run the workflow manually.

Requires:
- `yt-dlp` installed on the n8n host (`pip install -U yt-dlp`)
- An Anthropic credential set on the **Anthropic Chat Model** node
- Adjust `vaultPath` / `folder` in **Video Input** to match your Obsidian vault

See `references/n8n-workflow-setup.md` for full setup notes.

parameters.command:
=mkdir -p /tmp/video-watch && rm -f /tmp/video-watch/*.vtt /tmp/video-watch/meta.json
yt-dlp --dump-json --skip-download --no-warnings "{{ $json.videoUrl }}" > /tmp/video-watch/meta.json 2>/tmp/video-watch/meta.err
yt-dlp --skip-download --no-warnings --write-auto-sub --write-sub --sub-lang "en.*,en" --sub-format vtt --convert-subs vtt -o "/tmp/video-watch/%(id)s.%(ext)s" "{{ $json.videoUrl }}" 2>/tmp/video-watch/sub.err
echo "===META==="
cat /tmp/video-watch/meta.json 2>/dev/null
echo "===VTT==="
cat /tmp/video-watch/*.vtt 2>/dev/null
echo "===END==="

parameters.text:
=You are helping build a personal knowledge base note from a video transcript.

Video title: {{ $json.title }}
Creator: {{ $json.channel }}

Based on the transcript below, write markdown with exactly these sections:

## Summary
(2-4 sentence overview)

## Main Points
(bulleted list of the core content, in the order it builds)

## Nuances & Notable Details
(specific caveats, asides, examples, or contrarian takes the speaker emphasized that a generic summary would miss - look for moments like "most people get this wrong" or a specific number/threshold/exception)

## Actionable Insights
(checklist items - concrete steps the viewer could take, using "- [ ] ")

Transcript:
{{ $json.transcript }}
